form_details.description: Main headers and instructions for the form.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.value: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

footer_text.label: Footer Text
footer_text.value: Developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Janet B.W. Williams, Kurt Kroenke and colleagues, with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc. No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute.

options.description: The answer options and their point values for the main questions.
options.label: Answer Options

value.text: 1. Little interest or pleasure in doing things
3. Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
4. Feeling tired or having little energy
6. Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
7. Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
8. Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
9. Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

difficulty_section.description: The follow-up difficulty question at the end.

question_text.label: Difficulty Question Text
question_text.value: If you checked off any problems, how difficult have these problems made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?

difficulty_options.description: Answer options for the difficulty question.
difficulty_options.label: Difficulty Options
